simple.meaning: כַּוָּן (kavvân) is a Hebrew word meaning “something prepared , i.e. a sacrificial wafer.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.short: something prepared , i.e. a sacrificial wafer
definitions.full: H3561. kavvan [ כַּוָּן ] noun [masculine] cake, sacrificial cake (? √ כון ; compare Hiph`il 2. a. prepare food, etc.) **probably Babylonian loan-word, from kamânu , cake used in worship of Ištar, Zim KAT 3. 441 . — only plural absolute הַשָּׁמַיִם לִמְלֶכֶת כַּוָּנִים לַעֲשׂוֺת Jer 7:18 ; כ ׳לָהּ לְהַעֲצִבָהֿ עָשִׂינוּ 44:19 .

occurrences.englishText: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
“When we burned incense to the queen of the sky, and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”
